# GitHub Copilot Adapter

Follow `.github\instructions\documentation.instructions.md` for all
documentation and reports. It applies the repository ASD-STE100 rules.

Copilot-specific notes:

- Discover shared project skills in `.agents\skills\`.
- Discover native agents, prompts, hooks, and instruction adapters in
  `.github\`.
- Load shared MCP servers from `.mcp.json`.
- Treat `.codex\` as Codex runtime configuration.
- Keep GitHub-specific workflows and automation under `.github\`.
- Do not duplicate durable repository rules here. Update `AGENTS.md` instead.
